item.title: Tech sector welcomes tax proposals that bring clarity and stability
item.description: The Budget proposals on safe harbour margin and advance price mechanism are expected to bring clarity, predictability and stability in the tax regime for India's technology industry.

item.title: Industry leaders welcome Budget push for healthcare, manufacturing & deeptech as India moves towards self-reliant future
item.description: The Budget aims to create a balance between India’s agrarian roots and its deeptech ecosystem by prioritising future-ready infrastructure, say industry leaders.

item.title: Budget 2026 redraws India’s NBFC map, bets on fewer lenders to drive credit growth
item.description: Budget 2026 is being seen as a structural reset for India’s credit system. By consolidating public sector NBFCs into larger, sovereign-backed lenders, the government is betting on scale, technology and cheaper capital to drive MSME, infra and long-term credit growth, while squeezing smaller players.

item.title: A Budget for resilience in a fractured world
item.description: Nirmala Sitharaman’s ninth Budget in a row seeks to build resilience and relevance in an age of weaponised trade and geopolitical uncertainty.

item.title: Customs duty exemption for lithium-ion cell manufacturing extended to battery energy storage systems
item.description: Imports of key raw materials for EV batteries, including lithium oxide, hydroxide and lithium carbonates, now attract no basic customs duty as opposed to 7.5% levied earlier.

item.title: Tax sops for data centres, nuclear energy to help India attract $200B investments
item.description: In her budget speech, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a tax holiday for data centres and cloud service providers till 2047.
